title: monanthotaxis dielsiana
intro: Monanthotaxis dielsiana, commonly known as African boxwood or yellow boxwood, is a plant species in the Annonaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include the ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Monanthotaxis dielsiana include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, lignans, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
